About Me

Engineer, researcher, builder

I'm a first-year Computer Engineering grad student at UC Santa Cruz, with hands-on experience in generative AI, RAG systems, and data-driven strategy.

From leading a consulting team for an ed-tech startup to training LLM pipelines at the Tech4Good Lab, I love working where technology meets real-world problems.

Outside research, I run a Udemy programming course, founded Project Vendigo to address food insecurity, and create content on YouTube & Spotify.

Social Impact
🌿 Food Insecurity Initiative · Los Angeles

Project Vendigo

Founded to address the growing challenge of food insecurity across the Los Angeles region, Vendigo installs customized, free vending machines stocked with nutritious snacks in schools and communities most in need.

Using data-driven nutrition analysis and student consumption patterns, every machine is tailored to deliver real health benefits — not just calories. Featured on CBS News Los Angeles and recipient of the Point of Light Award.
